# Design decisions

Plumb's design decision log for Café Ünïcode. Append-only: one entry per decision.

## DS-20261001-direction · Direction: Warm counter
- Date: 2026-10-01
- Decided by: Zoë Brontë
- Options: Warm counter, Ledger, Field kit ([directions](directions.html))
- Chosen: Warm counter
- Why: Staff glance at it between orders; calm colours and big type win over density.
- Screens: all

## DS-20261005-booking-form · Booking form on one page
- Date: 2026-10-05
- Decided by: Łukasz Wójcik
- Options: one page form, three-step wizard
- Chosen: one page form
- Why: Most bookings are taken on the phone; the host needs every field at once. <em>No wizard.</em>
- Proposals: [booking variants](prototype/proposals/booking/index.html)
- Screens: booking
- Ticket: CAFE-012

## DS-20261009-tables-list · Today's tables as a time-ordered list
- Decided by: 山田 花子
- Options: list, floor plan
- Chosen: list
- Why: The floor plan hid the times, and times are what the host looks for first.
- Screens: home, menu

## Not a decision heading

Notes that are not entries are ignored.
